description: Create a browser extension project from a template in the extension.dev catalog. Call extension_templates first to see what is available. The scaffolder may initialize a git repository in the new project. Read the result's defaultsApplied block for that, and for every other decision made without being asked.

parentDir.description: Directory to create the project inside. Defaults to the MCP server process cwd, NOT the caller's cwd, so pass it whenever you care where the project lands. Aliases: parent, into.

projectName.description: Name of the extension project (used as directory name). Alias: name.

template.description: Template slug from the extension.dev catalog (e.g. 'react', 'ai-claude', 'content-vue'). extension_templates discovers them.

name: extension_create
